LESSON: WRITING 13.4.1 SPELLING

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Writing 13.4.1 Spelling

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing 13.4.1 Spelling. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to write words correctly? 2. How can we improve our spelling?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. spell words with double consonants correctly for clarity of writing,
2. construct correct sentences using words with double consonants for cohesive writing,

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing 13.4.1 Spelling.
2. Explain Writing 13.4.1 Spelling to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: construct sentences using words with double consonants,
4. Show that you can: spell words with double consonants correctly for clarity of writing,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 13.4.1 Spelling. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is it important to write words correctly? 2. How can we improve our spelling?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
